title: Rico Dowdle on Steelers backfield split: Put best foot forward, the rest takes care of itself

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rico Dowdle on Steelers backfield split: Put best foot forward, the rest takes care of itself
sources.description: Rico Dowdle emerged as the lead back with the Panthers during the 2025 season and posted his second straight 1,000-yard season, but he won't be back in Carolina for the 2026 campaign.
